name: Low-Carb Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy
ingredients_verbatim: 2 tbsp Wholesome Yum Blanched Almond Flour
8 oz Cremini mushrooms (sliced in 1/4 inch slices)
why: Classic ground-beef Salisbury steak patties in a cream-cheese mushroom gravy, cooked entirely in one skillet. Source publishes 409 cal / 7.2g carbs / 25.4g protein per serving - squarely low-carb and inside the 400-650 band (near the floor, so watch computed drift). Ground beef + mushrooms + beef broth all map to the board; almond flour (binder, small qty) and sugar-free ketchup are the only unmapped items - good pricer-lane exercise. Distinct low-carb variation vs the existing carb-heavy salisbury-steak-potato-bowls (no potato, mushroom-gravy base). Batch-scales cleanly to 14 as patties + shared gravy.
